 Torres and Al-Haj confirm Al-Hussein’s readiness for Iraqi Police clash 
 Al-Ghad
 last updated: 
 11 h ago 
 Torres and Al-Haj confirm Al-Hussein’s readiness for Iraqi Police clash 
 + 
 - 
 Al-Hussein Irbid head coach Koro Torres stressed the importance of the match against Iraq’s Al-Shorta, saying the team must approach it with the highest levels of concentration. He pointed to the team’s improving technical performance and ongoing efforts to strengthen its attacking effectiveness and cope with the pressure of a congested fixture schedule and the atmosphere created by the fans, as it seeks to secure all three points. اضافة اعلان 
The remarks came during a press conference ahead of the match between Al-Hussein Irbid and Al-Shorta, scheduled for Tuesday evening as part of the third round of Group D in the AFC Champions League Two.
Meanwhile, player Aref Al-Haj affirmed that his teammates were ready to deliver a performance worthy of Al-Hussein’s name and reflecting a positive image of Jordanian football. He expressed their determination to return with a positive result, while also praising the generous hospitality and warm reception in brotherly Iraq.
